# Pristine Perfume

> Pristine Perfume is a wholesale and retail attar and perfume oil supplier based in Kannauj, Uttar Pradesh, India — the traditional perfume capital of India. We specialize in authentic, alcohol-free attars distilled using the centuries-old deg-bhapka method, supplying retailers, resellers, and fragrance businesses across India.

Pristine Perfume offers a range of natural, oil-based attars including Mitti, Rose (Gulab), Sandal (Chandan), Oud, Mogra, and blended fragrances like Mukhallat Badar. All products are alcohol-free, traditionally distilled, and sold via transparent wholesale and retail pricing.
